name: Onna Senshi Chikan Jigoku
source:
An anime female solider stepped into a mysterious door, finding herself in a jam packed train in the real-life world.
She is encircled by a group of gropers in train. What is the fate of the solider.....?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ025451.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一位动漫女兵走进一扇神秘的门，发现自己身处现实世界的一列拥挤的火车里。
她在火车上被一群猥亵者包围。战士的命运又将如何……？

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ025451.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
